# Draft:Traditional names of places in Thrace

A number of place names in Anatolic Thrace changed over history, some during the Byzantine period like Byzantion / Constantinople, and others during the Turcocracy.
{| class="wikitable sortable" style=text-align:top;
!Original name|| Area || History || Current appellation
|- style=vertical-align:top
| Adrianople || Hébros valley || Ουσκουδάμα / Uskudama (Thracian)  Ὀρεστιάς / Orestias  Ἁδριανούπολις / Hadrianoúpolis  Andrinople, Одрин / Odrin (Bulgarian) || Edirne
|- style=vertical-align:top
| Arcadiopolis || Agriánēs valley || Βεργούλη / Bergoule Ἀρκαδιούπολις / Arkadioúpolis || Lüleburgaz
|- style=vertical-align:top
| Bisanthe || South coast || Βισάνθη / Bisánthe Ῥαιδεστός / Rhaidestós, Rodosto (Italian) || Tekirdağ (after the 18th century)
|- style=vertical-align:top
| Constantinople || Bosporus || Λύγος / Lygos, Βυζάντιον / Byzantion  Νέα Ῥώμη / Néa Rhṓmē  Κωνσταντινούπολις / Kōnstantinoúpolis  Kergustentin (Breton), Miklagard (Norse)  Tsarigrad (Slavic), Kostantiniyye, Stamboul || Istanbul
|- style=vertical-align:top
| Medea || East coast || Σαλμυδησσός / Salmydessos  Μήδεια / Medeia  Midye (until 1960) || Kıyıköy
|}
